==About==

{{i|Virginia Snail}}s are commonly found in the wild. Learning the [[Slug Hunting]] Skill increases your chances of finding Virginia Snails. Additionally, when Picking ripe {{i|Any Vegetable}}s which have sat for a day or two, you may occasionally find that a Virginia Snail has eaten one of your Vegetables and taken its [[Purity]].
